The user wants to ensure that if the LSP process crashes or becomes unresponsive, the application automatically detects it and restarts it without user intervention.

T1 found the mechanism: `health ok` detects the crash via a GET health timeout or HTTP failure, and `start completion server` triggers the restart if `health ok` fails or the stamp changes.

The user's request is "necesito que si el proceso del servidor de lenguaje LSP se cae o deja de responder, la aplicación lo detecte automáticamente y lo reinicie sin que el usuario tenga que hacer nada".

T1 confirmed the detection and restart mechanism exists.
